Create a brand-new photorealistic camera photograph-looking reconstruction for a Finnish game knowledge card, landscape 1536 x 1024, opaque. This is a fictional depiction of Finnish folk belief, photographed as if a real physical scene: a quiet Finnish forest on Midsummer night. Medium-wide low camera framing of damp moss, pine trunks, birch understory, a small natural stone cairn and a bracken fern. Beside the cairn, a modest pale blue-green ground flame rises only about 20 cm. The fern has ONE small, imagined pale flower as part of the same folklore fiction, visibly a subtle impossibility rather than botanical evidence. Realistic leaf texture, believable moisture, earth, stone and air; cool dim moonlight mixed with northern midsummer twilight. The flame is restrained, physically luminous, without magical particles or huge glow.
Style: indistinguishable from a real camera capture, fine photographic grain, quiet natural muted colors, convincing shadows, no painterly surfaces, no illustration, no cinematic saturation, no HDR. Keep fern, small flame and stone cairn fully within the central 16:9 crop-safe area; generous upper and lower background margins.
No people, no castle, no treasure visible, no words, letters, numbers, signs, logos, watermark or frame. Do not create an overwhelmingly magical fantasy aesthetic. This image depicts folk imagination, not a documented historical occurrence.

visualQA.notes: Folk-belief fiction: imagined fern flower and pale small ground flame; no castle or visible treasure.

builtInArguments.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Create a brand-new photorealistic camera photograph-looking fictional treasure hiding place for a Finnish game knowledge card. Landscape 1536 x 1024, opaque. Generic small medieval stone cellar, invented room, NOT a reconstruction of any documented Olavinlinna room. A rough low stone arch curves above a sturdy modest oak chest with a simple shield-shaped iron lock escutcheon. On a low stone ledge beside the chest: one medieval-form chalice, a silver bowl and a plain dark slate stone slab with NO markings. Two wax candles in plain iron holders produce the only warm light, restrained and believable; dim stone background remains visible. Medium-wide eye-level camera, natural perspective, materially realistic wood grain, hammered iron, silver patina, rough grey fieldstone and mortar. Objects and chest fully inside the central 16:9 crop-safe band, background margin above and below.
Style: looks like a real camera photograph of physical props in an actual stone cellar, muted natural colors, subtle sensor grain, honest candlelight, no painting, no drawn edges, no concept-art look, no HDR or excessive cinematic saturation. Period inspiration around 1495–1510, but explicitly fictional scene and fictional objects.
No people, no statues, no treasure sparkle or magic, no glass, no modern furnishings, no skulls, no readable marks on slate, no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark or frame. The chest lock is a plain shield-shaped metal escutcheon, no heraldic symbol or lettering.

visualQA.notes: Generic fictional cellar; plain shield lock, chalice, silver bowl, unmarked slate; fiction disclosed in caption and metadata.
